title: Generic's Weaponry
description: Adds weapons and utilities that can be used for fighting in minecraft.
body:
**Generic's Weaponry**
-
A mod that adds vanilla-esque weapons and utilities for fighting to Minecraft.
_________________
Keep in mind Curios API is required for some features to work.
______________

Current weapons:
- A dagger
- A hammer
- A sickle
- Throwing knives
______________
Other additions:
- Copper armor plating (can currently only be obtained from armorer Villagers)
________________

More stuff will be added in future updates.
